female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-specific-inventory-faster.title: Female borrowers who list a wide variety of specific inventory items fund faster.
female-specific-inventory-faster.body: Pitches from women that provide detailed lists of specific inventory items for their business are associated with increased funding speed.

demographic-details-slower-general.title: Including specific demographic details predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
demographic-details-slower-general.body: Pitches that explicitly mention age, marital status, number of children, or educational status are associated with slower funding speeds for both men and women.

loan-history-faster-general.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayments predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
loan-history-faster-general.body: Pitches from both men and women that reference successful past loan histories are associated with increased funding speed.

female-institutional-partner-faster.body: Female borrowers who explicitly name their institutional partner may fund faster.

male-loan-application-count-slower.body: Male borrowers who mention the specific number of previous loan applications may fund more slowly.

female-family-future-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention dreaming of securing their family's future may fund faster.

female-boilerplate-agri-slower.body: Female borrowers who use generic or identical phrasing regarding agricultural inputs may fund more slowly.

female-business-duration-slower.body: Female borrowers who specify the number of years they have operated their business may fund more slowly.

female-laudatory-language-slower.body: Female borrowers who use laudatory character descriptions, such as 'deserving candidate', may fund more slowly.

female-hardworking-entrepreneur-faster.body: Female borrowers who describe themselves as 'hardworking entrepreneurs' may fund faster.

community-benefit-faster-general.body: Pitches that mention benefits to the local community or neighbors may fund faster regardless of gender.

female-farm-expansion-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention the goal of expanding their farm may fund more slowly.

female-repayment-confidence-faster.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state their confidence or ability to repay the loan may fund faster.

female-broader-outcomes-faster.title: Female borrowers who link the loan to community wellbeing or family care may fund faster.
female-broader-outcomes-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentions of community economic growth correlate with slower funding

female-gratitude-faster.title: Female borrowers who include explicit expressions of gratitude to lenders or partners may fund faster.

female-local-detail-faster.title: Female borrowers who include detailed descriptions of local geography or tourism may fund faster.

female-training-details-faster.title: Female borrowers who provide specific details about their training may fund faster.

family-status-details-slower.title: Mentioning specific marital status or lack of dependents may predict slower funding regardless of gender.

children-education-faster.title: Mentioning the education of children predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
children-education-faster.retrospective: Dropped to make room for promoted claim regarding demographic details

female-collateral-mention-slower.title: Female borrowers who describe the microfinance program's role in providing loans without collateral may fund more slowly.
female-collateral-mention-slower.retrospective: Dropped to make room for new puzzle regarding professional descriptors

female-community-growth-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention contributing to community economic growth or food production may fund more slowly.
female-community-growth-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that benefits to local community correlate with faster funding

female-repayment-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their past loan repayment history fund faster.
female-repayment-history-faster.retrospective: Generalised to loan-history-faster-general after evidence appeared in both genders
